newsitem.title: RWANDA: Rwanda clamps down on entry without visas.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda clamps down on entry without visas.

text.p: Rwanda is strictly enforcing a ban on foreigners entering the central African country without a visa issued by a Rwandan embassy abroad.
"We have had two people turned away at the airport in the past two days," said an aid agency official in the Rwandan capital on Thursday. "They were ordered to get back on the plane and leave."

A senior immigration officer at Kigali airport confirmed people had been denied entry because they arrived without visas and said procedures were tightened up to stop "undesirables and people with questionable motives" from entering Rwanda.
Journalists and aid workers have flooded into Kigali in the past two months because of the return of hundreds of thosuands of refugees after two years on the move and in camps in Zaire and Tanzania.
Previously authorities issued temporary visas on arrival.
